newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen easier after mixed land auction.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen easier after mixed land auction.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to drift lower in a consolidation on Wednesday after Tuesday's mixed government land auction results, brokers said.
"After the slide on Tuesday, people are a bit cautious and the market is likely to head for a consolidation in slow trading," said Antony Mak, sales director ar Vickers Ballas.
The blue-chip Hang Seng Index dropped 230.73 points, or 1.54 percent, to close at 14,760.17 on Tuesday.
But Peter So, deputy head of research at Schroder Securities, said Tuesday's price fall was a bit overdone and properties should recover as the auction results were positive.
